title.value: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network
title.justification: This is the title of the paper as provided by the authors.
title.quote: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network

extractions.description: The paper proposes a machine learning-based framework to optimize handover parameters in cellular networks, addressing the growing complexity and size of these networks. The framework employs auto-grouping graph neural networks to effectively imitate the network environment and recommend parameter configurations. By doing so, it aims to improve network throughput, reduce maintenance costs, and enable better connectivity, including in underserved areas.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses primarily on optimizing cellular network performance rather than directly addressing sustainable development goals such as climate change or ecological impact.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Thus, improving the cellular network has both economic and social impact towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs).

secondary_categories.quote: It opens up the potential for high-quality internet access to geographical areas that are currently underserved by the cellular network.
